facts.fact: The deck says mobile money operators take part in the national instant payment system and that 7.23 million adults used mobile money in 2023.
The deck says the national switch gives account-to-account, wallet-to-wallet, account-to-wallet and wallet-to-account instant payments across banks and mobile money operators.
The deck says National Switch Limited is the digital public infrastructure integrating all commercial banks, mobile money operators, MFIs, SACCOs and fintechs for instant payments.
